Code to run:
text = captions
import re
speakers = re.findall(r"\[(.*?)\]:", text)
segments = re.split(r"\[.*?\]:", text)[1:]
keys = {"sooner":[],"soon":[],"earlier":[],"robots":[],"thinking machines":[]}
assoc = {}
for sp, seg in zip(speakers, segments):
    lower = seg.lower()
    matches = [k for k in keys if k in lower]
    if matches:
        assoc.setdefault(sp, []).extend(matches)
print(assoc)
